sources.title: Dissolved Oxygen Forecasting Dataset for Nile Tilapia Aquaculture
sources.role: DO forecasting candidate; separate offline pond and controlled-tank live validation
limitations: Short study; does not validate shrimp transfer.
Repository attribution and calibration must be reviewed against the original publication.
Author aggregates overlap raw data; never treat as independent validation.
Dictionary documents local Oman GMT+4; clock synchronization and received times remain unverified.
Only stated March26-April1 pond dates advance to preparation; 3207 later raw rows excluded pending context.
65 pond and 188 live hourly bins pass 11/12 subslot occupancy; candidate windows are very limited before partitioning.
Five pond/two tank one-hour-gap continuity candidates; earliest 5714-row pond group excluded pending source-order evidence. Physical site independence unknown.

High-frequency rapid DO changes and temperature plateaus are diagnostic review flags; broad numeric validity is not proof of independent calibration accuracy. Final target/input quality and bin policy pending.
sources.decision_reason: Traceable raw recordings and pinned license; usable sessions, calibration and timezone remain under scientific review.

sources.title: Dataset of water quality parameters (WP6 Cure4Aqua)
sources.role: Tank-level chemistry reference; establish cadence before forecasting
limitations: Flow-through/RAS tanks; species not established in downloaded metadata.
Parameter units differ; no automatic mmol/L, mg/L or percent-saturation conversion.
Zero values may be legitimate or missing placeholders; not reinterpreted.
sources.decision_reason: Downloaded workbook MD5 matches the saved Zenodo record; retain as tank-chemistry reference, not the initial hourly pond benchmark.

sources.title: Tiny ML Based Reconfigurable Water Buoy for Intensive Brackishwater Aquaculture
limitations: User supplied the downloaded archive from Downloads; publisher checksum not independently matched.
Data sheet contains malformed pH strings and values above 14, zero or large DO values, and a separate calculated-pH column requiring calibration review.
No explicit pond ID or timezone; exact species, concentration units and field-versus-calibration periods need confirmation.
Sheet2 appears to contain PH7/PH9 calibration readings and is retained as reference data.
77 timestamp-gap continuity groups are inspection candidates only; none establishes a verified pond or field/calibration session.
sources.decision_reason: Channel/session review completed: no justified pH or DO conversion, units and field identities unverified. Retain for exploration, exclude all channels from current supervised forecasting.
sources.redistribution_note: Await independent file identity confirmation; publisher page declares CC BY 4.0, but no publisher checksum was matched.

sources.title: Nutritious Pond On-farm field experiment in Vietnam-2016
sources.role: Shrimp farm water quality and management candidate
limitations: Publisher file API inaccessible in this run.
License, actual file schema and sampling cadence not yet verified.
sources.decision_reason: Candidate lead only; no acquired file or verified license/schema. Excluded from the current prepared release.

sources.title: IoT Monitoring Dataset of Water Quality and Tilapia Health in Monteria (2024)
sources.license: Unverified for local file; candidate publisher page license does not establish local-file identity
sources.role: Audit hourly water measurements; exclude rule-derived health/alert fields
limitations: Publisher says already interpolated.
Related release 8s73jfvgr5/3 describes six-hour readings; versions are not independent sources.
Local source identity/hash has not been matched to publisher file.
Many consecutive unchanged measurement vectors; investigate construction/interpolation.
Hourly row grid is verified but original sensor cadence is not; 90 fractional case rows and zero observed DO values below 5 prevent independent disease/hypoxia benchmark claims.
sources.local_provenance_note: User confirms files were collected online; original source links are unavailable. Listed publisher is a candidate, not verified local-file provenance.
sources.decision_reason: Cadence/label review found five 654-row and one 759-row constant water runs, fractional calendar/case fields and exact health-to-thermal-label mapping. Original measured-versus-filled status unknown; retain exploratory inspection only.
sources.candidate_publisher_license: CC BY 4.0 listed on candidate page

sources.title: An internet of things labelled dataset for aquaponics fish pond water quality monitoring system
sources.role: Candidate source for local O1D2 multi-pond CSVs
limitations: Local g/ml and mg/L headers conflict. No conversion is applied.
Chemical sensor calibration requires review; extreme concentration values remain flagged.
Cross-pond shared sequences must be checked before using a pond as holdout.
License of the exact local dataset release requires confirmation.

81,215 matching recorded timestamp/four-channel rows across Pond1/Pond2; longest adjacent source-order run is 54,501 rows. Local median positive source-order interval is 20 seconds, not proof of original cadence.
sources.local_provenance_note: User confirms files were collected online; original source links are unavailable. Listed publisher is a candidate, not verified local-file provenance.
sources.decision_reason: Unit/calibration/source identity unverified; faults and duplicated timestamp/four-water-channel segments documented. All channels exploratory-only; no nitrogen or DO model-target conversion approved.
sources.license: Unverified for local file; candidate publisher page license does not establish local-file identity

sources.title: Local O1D1 pond dataset variants
limitations: Original source links unavailable.
All 74,758 core measurement vectors in Fish Ponds occur in Ponds1 and Realtime-env2 at six-decimal comparison precision.
Timestamp/station provenance and any local transformations are unverified.
sources.decision_reason: Related local variants with unknown source and transformations; no independent benchmark or release approval.

sources.title: Local Realtime-env2 water and environmental table
limitations: Original source links and environmental-variable origins unavailable.
Lacks reliable pond identity; repeated times have conflicting water measurements.
Not independent of O1D1 variants.
sources.decision_reason: Provenance and pond identity are unresolved; environmental variables are not approved covariates.

sources.title: Local compilation workbook labeled shrimp water sensor data
limitations: Contains summaries, examples, related pond records and river-monitoring data.
A compilation title is not evidence that its rows are shrimp observations.
Original sources and reuse terms unavailable.
local_path_patterns: Copy of Shrimp water sensor data.xlsx
sources.decision_reason: Keep for background/lineage inspection only; individual blocks cannot inherit the workbook title as species provenance.

sources.title: Local archive containing Water_Quality_Assessment.csv
limitations: No verified author, license, acquisition URL or timestamp provenance.
The 1,000-row table cannot establish chronological forecasting skill.
sources.decision_reason: Untraceable, timestamp-free table; no supervised forecasting role.

disposition_definitions.eligible_candidate: Traceable source/reuse evidence; eligible for scientific review, not approval for training.
disposition_definitions.exploratory_only: Local inspection and preparation research only; not an approved benchmark, training release or raw-data redistribution.
disposition_definitions.reference_only: Background or schema/chemistry reference; no role as a forecasting target dataset in the first experiment.
disposition_definitions.excluded: Not part of the current prepared release. May be reconsidered with new evidence.
